title: the_dunwich_horror
author: H. P. Lovecraft
summary: In the decaying Massachusetts village of Dunwich, the wizard Old Whateley and his albino daughter raise the monstrous half-human Wilbur, spawned by the cosmic entity Yog-Sothoth; after Wilbur dies attempting to steal the Necronomicon, his gigantic invisible twin brother breaks loose and rampages until Dr. Armitage and colleagues destroy it with counter-sorcery atop Sentinel Hill.

issues.description: Opening bracketed transcriber's note about the etext source (Weird Tales April 1929) and copyright status appears at the very start of the story body.
The story text is truncated near the end (marked '[... text truncated ...]') during Armitage's closing explanation, cutting off the final resolution and denouement.
